description: Hello! This team for Space Mission Design Game. First time participants, making a simple rocket packing game balancing mass, budget, power. Looking for teammates interested in games, space, design. All levels welcome - let's build something fun for experience!
summary:
Space Mission Design Game - Interactive space simulation from Earth to Moon Base. Main pilot Cmdr. Nova.

Features:
A) Rocket Launch System: Interactive launchpad with countdown, stage separation, land on pad.
B) Flight Telemetry Dashboard: Zone Earth to Moon Base, Target Moon Base, Stage 1 Booster, Altitude 0m, Velocity 0m/s M0.0, G-Force 1.0G, Propellant Throttle 8% 100%, Transit 0%.
C) Space Navigation Map: Interactive map Earth/Moon selection, 2D Map & Pilot View, Route Earth-Moon Base, Local Gravity 9.81, transit visual.
D) Realistic Sounds via Web Audio API: 1. Pre-Ignition spool whine, 2. Ignition ascent blast, 3. Retro-burn braking, 4. Gear deployment, 5. Touchdown impact & dust.

Working: Rocket on pad, Start Countdown triggers ignition sound, telemetry updates altitude/velocity/G-force, controls for separate stage/landing, map shows route.

Tech: Google AI Studio, AI Model Gemini 4.1 Hydrogen (as screenshot), Web Technologies, Web Audio API.

Benefits: Makes ISRO/NASA missions easy, educational gaming, engaging.

Future: Add Mars/Jupiter/Saturn, 3D planets, astronaut missions, more challenges.

Title: Space Mission Design Game, Category: Educational Simulation, Mission: Earth to Moon Base.
details: Orbital Launch - Build Your Own Space Program Interactive launch simulator. Main module "Pilot: Cmdr. Nova" launches rocket from Earth Cape Pad to Moon Base. 3 Panels: Left: Telemetry - Zone Earth to Moon, Stage 1 Booster, Altitude 0m, Velocity 0m/s M0.0, G-Force 1.0G, Propellant Throttle 8% 100%, Transit 0%. Buttons: Start Countdown, Land, Separate Stage. Center: Visual of Cmdr. Nova rocket on launchpad with tower. Live lift-off. Right: Flight Map showing Earth to Moon dotted trajectory, Route, Local Gravity 9.81 m/s², Transit %. Benefits: Teaches real physics to students in game format, inspires ISRO/NASA careers, mobile-friendly, low data. Tools: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, JS physics. Built with Emergent.sh, Google AI Studio, GitHub, VS Code. Creativity: Combined 5 refs - Launch Centre, Rocket Flight, Workshop, Galaxy Map, Moon Base. Clean 3-button UI vs complex games. Blue HUD style. Factors: Mobile-first for Mysuru, portrait/landscape, battery, offline, accurate physics, fun.
